description: Share of completed Client CI runs each day that failed or timed out. Cancelled and skipped runs are not counted.

tiers.0: Within the usual range. Nothing to do.
tiers.1: Above one standard deviation. Logged in the workflow summary only.
tiers.2: A sustained rise. The ci-health issue is opened or updated and Claude adds a read-only diagnosis.
tiers.3: Above three standard deviations. Treat as urgent: fix forward or revert through a pull request.
